{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[cookbook:water|water]]
* ¼ cup (60 ml) granulated [[Cookbook:White Sugar|white sugar]]
* 1 tsp [[cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]] (optional)

== Procedure ==

# Combine pepper, water, sugar and lemon in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and heat slowly until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is a light-brown colour.
# Remove from heat and let cool for 1 hour.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* The lemon juice can be replaced by lemon rind, or lime.
* Makes a good sauce for fresh fruit or fruit with soured cream.
